current_objective: Get Oak's Parcel from Viridian Poke Mart

waypoints.description: Walk DOWN to exit current building
Go to Viridian Poke Mart, get Oak's Parcel
Deliver parcel to Oak, GET POKÉDEX

notes: This path is critical as the Pokédex is required for progression. The agent needs to first acquire Oak's Parcel and deliver it to Professor Oak to obtain the Pokédex, which is necessary for capturing Pokémon and completing the game.
